Round 2 — DSA Challenge: Easy: Solve 3 beginner-friendly DSA problems and put your fundamental problem-solving skills to the test. Round 3 — DSA Challenge: Medium & Hard: Ready for the real challenge? Take on 3 advanced DSA problems designed to test your logic, optimization, and coding ability. Who Can Participate? DSAverse is open to girls and women who are passionate about coding and technology, whether you’re a beginner exploring DSA or an experienced competitive programmer. Why Participate? Challenge yourself with problems across different difficulty levels Test your DSA and problem-solving skills Compete with talented women developers Showcase your coding abilities Earn recognition as one of the top performers Become a part of the Elite Her community Think. Solve. Code. Conquer the DSAverse.

raw.details:
DSAverse By Elite Her

DSAverse by Elite Her is a girls-only coding challenge designed to test your problem-solving skills, programming fundamentals, and Data Structures & Algorithms knowledge.

Whether you’re just getting started with DSA or you’re already comfortable solving challenging problems, DSAverse gives you a platform to learn, compete, and showcase your coding skills.

What’s In DSAverse?

Round 1 — The Quiz:

  • Test your knowledge of programming, DSA, and computer science fundamentals through an engaging quiz.

Round 2 — DSA Challenge: Easy:

  • Solve 3 beginner-friendly DSA problems and put your fundamental problem-solving skills to the test.

Round 3 — DSA Challenge: Medium & Hard:

  • Ready for the real challenge? Take on 3 advanced DSA problems designed to test your logic, optimization, and coding ability.

Who Can Participate?

DSAverse is open to girls and women who are passionate about coding and technology, whether you’re a beginner exploring DSA or an experienced competitive programmer.

Why Participate?

  • Challenge yourself with problems across different difficulty levels
  • Test your DSA and problem-solving skills
  • Compete with talented women developers
  • Showcase your coding abilities
  • Earn recognition as one of the top performers
  • Become a part of the Elite Her community

Think. Solve. Code. Conquer the DSAverse.
